Game Overview

At its heart, Happy Devil and UnHappy Angel is a adventure game about embark on a pixel-art adventure through Hell as a mischievous devil and a freedom-seeking angel. Navigate treacherous paths, solve puzzles, and outsmart monstrous foes to gather golden keys and find the elusive orange fruit. Teamwork and strategy are your allies in this charming co-op escape.
